findings.mechanism: Masking changes target_metrics and time_index only, then persists the whole dictionary. A constructed future_derived_outcome column retains post-cutoff90000/90100; actual replica adapter forwards the correct snapshot and the fixture delegate reads these values from that same bound view.
findings.preserve: Correct target prefix, source immutability, exact snapshot binding and request mismatch refusal. Some exogenous future-known fields may be legitimate, so do not blindly truncate every list.
findings.remaining: At existing historical data owner declare and verify temporal/availability roles of supplied features; do not include unclassified post-cutoff outcome-derived fields in an admitted replay view. Derived features must be computed from admissible inputs, not merely truncated afterwards.
findings.limits: Future values are proven accessible in the actual masked payload under fixture workflow/CAS. No actual production model was shown to consume this field or change its forecast.

findings.mechanism: After a completed Scientist replica and persisted cohort, scalar without profile or wrong trajectory length returns a new naive payload without replica_cohort_ref. Actual _run_single_scenario propagates no cohort ref; report writer only adds cohort edges found in scenario metadata.
findings.preserve: Reject arbitrary scalar and wrong-length trajectory; keep explicit degraded naive result and all persisted raw artifacts.
findings.remaining: Reuse the existing _naive_with_cohort path or equivalent projection to carry the already persisted cohort ref through this fallback; do not rerun failed semantic projection or delete useful replica records.
findings.limits: Actual prediction/scenario methods and evaluator executed with explicit fixture workflow/Foundry/CAS. Native aggregate persistence not executed; missing report edge is source-traced, not native attested.

findings.mechanism: Earlier exact metrics_ref matches SimulationResult, but later code rereads by ArtifactID and _is_constant_forecast reads default manifest. With identical bytes and sibling profiles, selected valid producer/default foreign producer loses valid forecast; selected no producer/default matching producer admits scalar.
findings.preserve: Full typed profile, outcome_trajectory estimand, horizon and producer binding checks; physical request binding profile protection already exists.
findings.remaining: Carry the original selected MetricsRef through payload read and manifest producer check; same discipline for any selected uncertainty profile at constant-profile check.
findings.limits: Actual control flow exercised with an explicit multi-profile fixture store; native Core CAS was not run. This proves selector loss and conditional admission result, not external authority/production bypass.

findings.remaining: Current constant profile validates unique time labels and horizon but does not compare them to held-out coordinates; same-length list accepts caller metadata mean_ate/wrong dates. Bind trajectory quantity/unit/baseline/time origin and coordinates through existing producer contract before a historical forecast interpretation. Keep correct stationary constant forecast and already-computed draws; no forced model rerun.
findings.limits: P19/P20 retain missing-envelope degradation; they do not establish positive interval/production admission. General list semantic capability remains unqualified even though original scalar and length defects improved.

findings.remaining: Native workflow/Foundry/CAS, supported uncertainty admission, budget and actual cost must be checked in supported environment. Distinct requests/seeds are not proof of independent Monte Carlo draws. Multi-run artifacts are retained but no joint forecast projection is configured; qualify a useful supported summary through existing computation owner rather than average into scalar.
findings.limits: 24 bounded MATCH; actual request/seed DTO and adapter bodies, fixture execution. Native test attempt missing pytest before collection. No dependency installation.
